orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
WPMS No. 826 of 2019 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Anil Kumar Joshi, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
There is no representation for 
respondent. 
List this matter after four weeks. 
Till next date of listing, petitioner shall 
not be evicted from the property in question 
pursuant to the impugned orders, provided 
petitioner pays a sum of ` 5,000/- per 
month w.e.f. September, 2019 for use and 
occupation of the property in question on or 
before 10th day of each succeeding month to 
the landlord (respondent herein), without 
prejudice to his rights and contentions. 
Stay application (CLMA No. 3881 of 
2019) stands disposed of. 
Let a certified copy of this order be 
issued today itself. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 19.09.2019
Navin

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 826 of 2019
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Chetan Joshi, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. 
Anil Kumar Joshi, learned counsel for the Petitioner. 
2. Mr. B. S. Kathayat, learned counsel for the 
Respondent. 
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the Petitioner 
seeks adjournment on the personal ground, whereas it has 
been opposed by learned counsel for the Respondent. 
4. As per office report dated 29.12.2025, Vakalatnama
has been filed by Mr. B. S. Kathayat, learned counsel for the 
Respondent. 
5. Learned counsel for the Respondent submits that he is 
representing the landlord in whose favour release application 
regarding property in question was granted and the Petitioner 
on one pretext or the other has been lingering on the present 
matter ever since its inception i.e. 29.03.2019 and interim in 
favour of the Petitioner had already been granted by the 
Coordinate Bench vide order dated 19.09.2019. 
6. List this matter on 20.02.2026 for final hearing. 
7. It is clarified that adjournment shall not be granted to 
either of the parties on the next date fixed. In case, learned 
counsel for the petitioner seeks adjournment, then the interim 
order shall stand vacated. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 30.12.2025
Akash
